business_summary: Iyogin Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in Japan. It operates in two segments, Banking and Leasing. The company offers deposit, lending, securities investment, foreign exchange, banking outsourcing, credit guarantee, credit card, and investment fund management services. It also engages in the leasing of office equipment, industrial machinery, machine tools, medical equipment, and others; automotive maintenance lease; and installment payment sales contracts and loans. In addition, the company is involved in information processing outsourcing, software development and sale, and office automation equipment sale; mortgage and consumer loan debt guarantees; cash management and verification work, as well as ATM maintenance management work; and investment activities in stocks and corporate bonds, as well as management and administration of investment partnership assets. Further, it engages in business consulting, industry survey, contract research, and publication; warranty services; intermediation, brokerage, and agency services for the buying and selling of securities; printing and binding services for documents and other forms; manufacturing and sale of wood products, textiles, and office supplies; and debt management and collection services, as well as debt purchase services. The company was formerly known as The Iyo Bank, Ltd. and changed its name to Iyogin Holdings, Inc. in October 2022. Iyogin Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.
